snippet.title: Company of Heroes – Definitive Edition Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Company of Heroes – Definitive Edition is the ultimate Company of Heroes experience, including the original game and both expansions, enhanced visuals and rendering, modernized controls, and 64-bit support for modern systems and mods.

Coming Fall 2026.

Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4691270/Company_of_Heroes__Definitive_Edition/
